tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and stop at H=0.48, far short of the target H=21.9. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the gain reverses and helps constrain the slow adaptation term before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential adaptation law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant, leaving the sign and magnitude at H=21.9 uncertain.
Positive short-window gains do not distinguish monotone saturation from a delayed reversal.
Finer short-window sampling is less diagnostic than measuring directly at long horizons.
